probes.question: "Concorde fallacy" is another name for which idea?
True or false: the term "Concorde fallacy" derives from the British and French governments continuing to fund the joint development of Concorde.

image.alt: A black-and-white photo of a Concorde supersonic airliner flying low over an airport

body.claim: The sunk cost fallacy has also been called the "Concorde fallacy".
body.why: The British and French governments continued to fund the joint development of the costly Concorde supersonic airplane even after it became apparent that there was no longer an economic case for the aircraft.
